projection.camera: 3/4 from S at 40 deg (ADR 0006/0022 boat bake)
projection.key: upper-left; W facets lit, E shaded, S base
projection.noise: pure function of global pixel coords; tiles are seamless and never repeat

water.contract: ADR 0010/0012/0023 — the shader owns ALL water
water.note: no waterline, foam, swash or shallows pixels anywhere in this kit

Fringe.png.use: stamp over the LOWER material's ground tile; the higher material laps onto it

Cliff.png.stack: cap + mid x N + toe = any height; strata key on global row Y so bands align

Dune.png.note: cap + toe = a 2 m bank; cap alone = 1 m

Contact.png.use: stamp on the GROUND tile a landform stands next to — bakes the ambient occlusion v7 had none of

rockProps.note: sea stacks, skerries, outcrops, erratics, tide-pool ledges and cobble scatters are Rock Iso volumes with anchors. ShoreIso2 shares its red-sandstone ramp verbatim.

api: globalThis.ShoreIso2 — ground(mat,{gx,gy,seed,style}) · fringe(mat,piece,{...}) · cliff(piece,{band,gy,gx,seed,feature,style}) · column(piece,rows,{...}) · dune(piece,{band,...}) · contact(piece,{style})
